meta.title: Projects
meta.description: Your iynk projects, kept in this browser. Create, rename, duplicate, save to a file and restore.

title: Projects
lede: Everything here is stored in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.

storage.label: Space used
storage.unknown: This browser does not say how much space is left.

list.title: Your projects
list.failed: The projects could not be read. Reload the page to try again.
list.emptyBody: Start with a Blink project for the Uno. It is saved in this browser as you go.

row.couldNotOpen: Could not open this project. Save to file keeps a copy of what is stored.
row.failed: That did not work. Try again.

selected.title: Open project
selected.name: Name

trash.title: Trash
trash.lede: Deleted projects stay here for 30 days.

banner.recovered: The last save of {name} was damaged, so the previous copy was opened.
banner.lostTitle: A project could not be read
banner.lost: Both saved copies of {name} are damaged. Nothing was deleted.
banner.quota: The browser has no room left for this project. Save to file, then delete something you no longer need.
banner.otherTab: A project was saved in another tab. The list is up to date.
banner.file: Some projects have been here for over 10 minutes without a copy in a file. Save to file keeps a copy you control.
banner.newerTitle: This file is from a newer iynk
banner.newer: {name} was saved by a newer version, so it cannot be opened here. Download gives the file back unchanged.
banner.importTitle: That file could not be opened
banner.importDamaged: {name} is not a valid iynk project.

status.importedForked: Opened {name} from file as a new project
